title: Second coordinate of a normalized pair sum
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every pair $x,y\in\{ -1,1\}^n$ of sign vectors, the second coordinate of their normalized correlated sum is $(\sqrt n)^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^n y_i$.
